FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Okanagan Crossing Pipelines Ltd.
REPORTED BY
Control-room operator
RECEIVED VIA
Text messages
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
"found gas release near Slave Lake, AB at 12:45 today. Patrol spotted it on scheduled check.
product is sweet natural gas. metering says 12.0 m³ released. release rate was 0.04 kg/s. all
stayed inside station fence. just a heads up."
followed by a second text:
"just confirming, release was at 12:45, metering and rate checks were done after that, not sure if
at same time or slightly after. will send more info if we get it."
-J. Lee, CRO
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
